instructions: Read every complete case in the paired workbook. The default is only a draft. Put a full Decision object in Override for every contradiction, then sign reviewedAllCases. The compiler refuses unsigned or candidate-less rows.

rows.Kwic: 外空諸見，內絕心智，徹底平常，騰騰任運，為內外護流通大法。

Override.AttributionNote: Essentials of Mind by Chan Master Foguo Keqin (佛果克勤禪師心要), in Yuanwu Keqin's instruction headed ‘To a Chan Person’ (示禪人). Yuanwu Keqin is the exact author who says that after meeting the opportunity one is thoroughly ordinary and ‘rolls along, letting things run,’ protecting and circulating the great teaching inwardly and outwardly.
